LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Lathander.descOverrid: Lathander's festival: celebrate rebirth in the morning light. +10% quality when started by day. When unforgettable: 3 days of "favor of the dawn" (Lathander's blessing).
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Lathander.ritualExpec: Every year on {DATE}, {MEMBERS} hold Greengrass for Lathander.
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Tyr.descOverride: Tyr's festival: reaffirm vows and settle disputes. Every 4 years (years divisible by 4) is a Great Shieldmeet: divine favor result ×1.5. When unforgettable: the leader swears a vow (30 days: melee hit +5, social fight chance ×0.5).
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Tyr.ritualExpectedDes: Every year on {DATE}, {MEMBERS} hold the Shieldmeet for Tyr.
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Mystra.descOverride: Mystra's festival: salute the Weave under the stars. +10% quality when started at night, +3% for each spellcasting participant. When unforgettable: participants' psyfocus is refilled, psychic sensitivity +10% for 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Mystra.ritualExpected: Every year on {DATE}, {MEMBERS} hold the Night of the Weave for Mystra.
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Kelemvor.descOverride: Kelemvor's festival: share a meal with the departed and send off restless spirits. +10% quality when there's an occupied grave or sarcophagus on the map. When unforgettable: all humanlike corpses on the map are laid to rest, participants get mood +5 (10 days).
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Kelemvor.ritualExpect: Every year on {DATE}, {MEMBERS} hold the Feast of the Dead for Kelemvor.
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Malar.descOverride: Malar's festival: offer prey to the Beastlord. At the start there must be an animal corpse of body size ≥0.7 within 3 cells of the altar, offered when the festival ends. When unforgettable: participants get melee hit +5 and shooting accuracy +5% for 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Malar.ritualExpectedD: Every year on {DATE}, {MEMBERS} hold the Great Hunt for Malar.
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Talos.descOverride: Talos's festival: sing loud in the gale. +25% quality in a thunderstorm. When unforgettable: 3 days of Talos's blessing.
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Talos.ritualExpectedD: Every year on {DATE}, {MEMBERS} hold the Storm Song for Talos.
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Bane.descOverride: Bane's festival: swear obedience to the Black Hand. +5% quality for each slave present (up to +20%). When unforgettable: suppression of all slaves on the map +20%.
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Bane.ritualExpectedDe: Every year on {DATE}, {MEMBERS} hold the Day of Tyranny for Bane.
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Shar.descOverride: Shar's festival: forget pain in darkness. +20% quality at night, another +10% when the altar's cell has under 30% light. When unforgettable: participants get melee dodge +8 for 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Shar.ritualExpectedDe: Every year on {DATE}, {MEMBERS} hold the Lightless Vigil for Shar.
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Surtr.descOverride: Surtur's festival: cast the finest arms and armor into the forge. At the start there must be weapons or armor worth ≥300 in total within 3 cells of the altar, offered when the festival ends. When unforgettable: participants get smithing speed +25% for 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_FestivalPattern_Surtr.ritualExpectedD: Every year on {DATE}, {MEMBERS} hold the Forgefire for Surtur.
LanguageData.LP_FuneralGreyRobe.ritualExpectedDesc: A grey-robed funeral can be held for {PAWN_nameDef}.
LanguageData.LP_FuneralGreyRobe.ritualExpectedDescNoA: A grey-robed funeral can be held for {PAWN_nameDef}.
